blocks.zh: 中文解說
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: ISO 15394 的歷史脈絡
blocks.en: History of ISO 15394

blocks.zh: 本標準由 ISO/TC 122（包裝技術委員會）制定，目前為第三版（2017年），取代2009年第二版。對製藥CDMO而言，關鍵變更在於：
blocks.en: This standard was developed by ISO/TC 122 (Packaging) and is now in its third edition (2017), replacing the second edition of 2009. For a pharmaceutical CDMO, the key changes are:

blocks.zh: 5.5 新增「資料區域識別」：要求每個資料區域須標示對應標題（如 SSCC、SHIP TO），強化標籤可讀性
blocks.en: 5.5 adds "data area identification": each data area must carry a corresponding title (such as SSCC or SHIP TO), improving label readability

blocks.zh: 5.4 結構調整：結構化資料檔案（含運輸文件、EDI訊息）規定更清楚
blocks.en: 5.4 restructured: the rules for structured data files (including transport documents and EDI messages) are clearer

blocks.zh: 附錄 E 新增多個標籤範例圖（E.11–E.13）及資料表（E.1–E.2）
blocks.en: Annex E adds several label example figures (E.11-E.13) and data tables (E.1-E.2)

blocks.zh: 比喻：ISO 15394 就像「出貨標籤的憲法」
blocks.en: Analogy: ISO 15394 is the "constitution of shipping labels"

blocks.zh: 就像憲法規定法律的基本框架，ISO 15394 定義了出貨標籤的最低要求——不論是藥廠、食品廠還是汽車零件廠，只要有物流標籤就得遵守這套框架。各行業再根據自己需求制定應用指引（Application Guidelines）。
blocks.en: Just as a constitution sets the basic framework for laws, ISO 15394 defines the minimum requirements for shipping labels. Whether you are a pharmaceutical plant, a food plant or an automotive parts plant, any logistics label has to follow this framework. Each industry then develops its own Application Guidelines to suit its needs.

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要標準化出貨條碼？
blocks.en: Why standardize shipping barcodes?

blocks.zh: 核心問題與解決方案
blocks.en: The core problem and the solution

blocks.zh: 問題：全球供應鏈中，不同行業（藥廠、食品、汽車）各自有不同的標籤格式，導致貨物到達倉庫後，掃描器無法自動辨識，需要人工重新輸入資料。
blocks.en: Problem: In the global supply chain, each industry (pharma, food, automotive) uses its own label format. When goods arrive at a warehouse, scanners cannot read the labels automatically and the data has to be re-keyed by hand.

blocks.zh: 解決：ISO 15394 提供統一的多行業框架，讓條碼標籤成為連結實體貨物與電子資料（EDI）的橋梁。
blocks.en: Solution: ISO 15394 provides a unified multi-industry framework that makes the barcode label a bridge between the physical goods and the electronic data (EDI).

blocks.zh: 製藥人員須知
blocks.en: What pharma staff need to know

blocks.zh: ISO 15394 是物流層（外箱/棧板）的標籤標準；
blocks.en: ISO 15394 is the label standard for the logistics level (shipping cartons/pallets);

blocks.zh: ISO 22742 是產品層（單盒/銷售包裝）的標籤標準。
blocks.en: ISO 22742 is the label standard for the product level (single packs/saleable packaging).

blocks.zh: 兩者互補——DSCSA 和 EU FMD 的序列號要求同時涉及這兩個層面。
blocks.en: The two are complementary: the serialization requirements of the DSCSA and the EU FMD involve both levels.

blocks.zh: 比喻：條碼標籤是供應鏈的「身份證」
blocks.en: Analogy: the barcode label is the supply chain's "ID card"

blocks.zh: 每個運輸單元（棧板、外箱）都需要一張「身份證」（唯一識別碼）。當 EDI 系統與物流系統連線時，掃描這張身份證就能取得所有電子資料，無需人工輸入。這正是 SSCC（序列貨運箱代碼）的核心功能。
blocks.en: Every transport unit (pallet, shipping carton) needs an "ID card" (a unique identifier). When the EDI system is linked to the logistics system, scanning this ID card retrieves all the electronic data without manual entry. This is exactly the core function of the SSCC (Serial Shipping Container Code).

blocks.zh: 範圍解析——哪些情境適用？
blocks.en: Scope analysis: which situations apply?

blocks.zh: 製藥 CDMO 實務重點
blocks.en: Practical points for a pharmaceutical CDMO

blocks.zh: 製藥出貨標籤通常有三個層次：
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical shipping labels usually work at three levels:

blocks.zh: 棧板標籤：SSCC(00) + 外箱數量 + 批號
blocks.en: Pallet label: SSCC (00) + number of cartons + lot number

blocks.zh: 外箱標籤：SSCC(00) 或 GTIN(01) + 批號(10) + 有效期(17) + 序號(21)
blocks.en: Shipping carton label: SSCC (00) or GTIN (01) + lot number (10) + expiry date (17) + serial number (21)

blocks.zh: 出貨文件連結：2D符號（PDF417 或 DataMatrix）可含完整 EDI 資料
blocks.en: Link to shipping documents: a 2D symbol (PDF417 or DataMatrix) can carry the complete EDI data

blocks.zh: 規範性引用文件解析
blocks.en: Analysis of the normative references

blocks.zh: GS1 General Specifications 的地位
blocks.en: The status of the GS1 General Specifications

blocks.zh: GS1 General Specifications 是 GS1 組織（負責 SSCC、GTIN、GS1-128 等系統）的核心文件，ISO 15394 直接引用它作為規範性依據。製藥公司加入 GS1 會員後，才能取得合法的 GS1 Company Prefix，進而生成有效的 SSCC 和 GTIN。
blocks.en: The GS1 General Specifications are the core document of the GS1 organization (responsible for systems such as SSCC, GTIN and GS1-128), and ISO 15394 cites it directly as a normative basis. A pharmaceutical company must become a GS1 member before it can obtain a legitimate GS1 Company Prefix, and only then generate valid SSCCs and GTINs.

blocks.zh: Code 39：較舊，僅支援大寫英數字，搭配 ANSI DI（Data Identifier）使用。
blocks.en: Code 39: older; supports upper-case alphanumeric characters only, and is used with the ANSI DI (Data Identifier).

blocks.zh: Code 128：現代版，支援 ASCII 全字元集，可搭配 GS1 AI 或 ANSI DI。
blocks.en: Code 128: the modern version; supports the full ASCII character set and can be used with GS1 AIs or ANSI DIs.

blocks.zh: GS1-128：Code 128 的子集，只使用 GS1 Application Identifiers，是製藥出貨標籤的主流選擇。
blocks.en: GS1-128: a subset of Code 128 that uses only GS1 Application Identifiers; it is the mainstream choice for pharmaceutical shipping labels.

blocks.zh: 術語快速對照
blocks.en: Quick terminology comparison

blocks.zh: SSCC vs GTIN vs SGTIN — 三者差異
blocks.en: SSCC vs GTIN vs SGTIN: how the three differ

blocks.zh: SSCC 是「裝載容器」的識別碼；GTIN 是「產品型號」的識別碼；SGTIN = GTIN + 序號，用於單品追蹤。
blocks.en: The SSCC identifies a "loaded container"; the GTIN identifies a "product type"; the SGTIN = GTIN + serial number, used for item-level tracking.

blocks.zh: HRI vs 條碼：「人看 vs 機器看」
blocks.en: HRI vs barcode: "read by people vs read by machines"

blocks.zh: 條碼/2D符號：機器（掃描器、倉儲系統）讀取，傳輸資料。
blocks.en: Barcode/2D symbol: read by machines (scanners, warehouse systems) to transmit data.

blocks.zh: HRI（人類可讀解讀）：印在條碼旁邊的數字/文字，讓操作員在掃描器故障時可以手動鍵入。
blocks.en: HRI (human-readable interpretation): the digits/text printed next to the barcode so that operators can key the data in manually if the scanner fails.

blocks.zh: ISO 15394 要求線性條碼旁必須印 HRI，2D 符號則為選項。
blocks.en: ISO 15394 requires HRI to be printed next to linear barcodes (mandatory); for 2D symbols it is optional.

blocks.zh: Quiet Zone 靜區的重要性
blocks.en: Why the quiet zone matters

blocks.zh: 靜區是條碼左右兩側的空白區域。若靜區不足，掃描器可能誤讀邊界，導致掃描失敗。GS1-128 規定最小靜區寬度為 10X（X = 最小模塊寬度）。製藥標籤印刷驗證時，靜區測量是 GS1 Barcode Verification 的必檢項目。
blocks.en: The quiet zone is the blank area on the left and right of a barcode. If it is insufficient, the scanner may misread the boundary and the scan fails. GS1-128 specifies a minimum quiet zone width of 10X (X = minimum module width). When verifying the print quality of pharmaceutical labels, measuring the quiet zone is a mandatory item in GS1 barcode verification.

blocks.zh: 雙層架構解析
blocks.en: The two-layer architecture explained

blocks.zh: 兩層架構：資料內容 vs 資料載體
blocks.en: Two layers: data content vs data carrier

blocks.zh: ISO 15394 的核心設計哲學是將「要傳遞什麼資料」與「用什麼符號承載」分開處理：
blocks.en: The core design philosophy of ISO 15394 is to treat "what data is to be conveyed" separately from "which symbol carries it":

blocks.zh: 類比：資料內容 = 你想說的話；資料載體 = 你用什麼語言說（英文/中文）。
blocks.en: Analogy: data content = what you want to say; data carrier = the language you say it in (English/Chinese).

blocks.zh: 運輸單元層次結構（製藥場景）
blocks.en: Transport unit hierarchy (pharmaceutical scenario)

blocks.zh:
棧板 Pallet（Unit Load）
貼 SSCC 標籤 AI(00)
blocks.en:
Pallet (Unit Load)
Carries an SSCC label, AI (00)

blocks.zh:
外箱 Shipping Carton（Transport Package）
貼 SSCC 或 GTIN+Lot+Exp+Ser
blocks.en:
Shipping Carton (Transport Package)
Carries an SSCC, or GTIN + Lot + Exp + Ser

blocks.zh:
銷售包裝 Saleable Unit
ISO 22742 管轄，DSCSA/EU FMD 序列化
blocks.en:
Saleable Unit
Governed by ISO 22742; DSCSA/EU FMD serialization

blocks.zh: Base Label（基本標籤）：只包含最少必要資料——SSCC（唯一識別碼）+ Ship To 地址。當 EDI 系統完備時，掃描 SSCC 就能從資料庫取得所有資訊。
blocks.en: Base Label: contains only the minimum necessary data: the SSCC (unique identifier) + the Ship To address. When the EDI system is fully in place, scanning the SSCC retrieves all the information from the database.

blocks.zh: Extended Label（擴展標籤）：當 EDI 不完備或貿易夥伴有額外需求時使用，在標籤上直接印批號、有效期、產品描述等。製藥出貨標籤通常使用擴展標籤。
blocks.en: Extended Label: used when EDI is incomplete or trading partners have additional needs; the lot number, expiry date, product description and so on are printed directly on the label. Pharmaceutical shipping labels normally use the extended label.

blocks.zh: GS1 Application Identifier 速查表
blocks.en: GS1 Application Identifier quick reference

blocks.zh: 製藥出貨標籤實際 AI 碼範例
blocks.en: Examples of actual AI codes on pharmaceutical shipping labels

blocks.zh: 場景：CDMO 出貨棧板標籤
blocks.en: Scenario: CDMO pallet shipping label

blocks.zh:
產品：注射用粉末，GTIN = 07612345678900
批號：TW-2601A，有效期：2027-12-31
數量：120 外箱／棧板，序號：SN0000001（棧板級）
blocks.en:
Product: powder for injection, GTIN = 07612345678900
Lot number: TW-2601A, expiry date: 2027-12-31
Quantity: 120 cartons per pallet, serial number: SN0000001 (pallet level)

blocks.zh: GS1-128 條碼編碼（棧板 SSCC 條碼）：
blocks.en: GS1-128 barcode encoding (pallet SSCC barcode):

blocks.zh: GS1-128 條碼編碼（外箱標籤，多 AI 串接）：
blocks.en: GS1-128 barcode encoding (shipping carton label, multiple concatenated AIs):

blocks.zh: 紅色 [FNC1] 表示可變長度欄位的分隔符。固定長度欄位（如 (01) 14位、(17) 6位）後面不需要 FNC1。
blocks.en: The red [FNC1] marks the separator for variable-length fields. Fixed-length fields (such as (01), 14 digits, and (17), 6 digits) need no FNC1 after them.

blocks.zh: FNC1 分隔符的作用
blocks.en: The role of the FNC1 separator

blocks.zh: 在 GS1-128 中，AI 有固定長度和可變長度兩種：
blocks.en: In GS1-128, AIs have either a fixed length or a variable length:

blocks.zh: 固定長度（如 (01) = 14位，(17) = 6位）：掃描器知道讀幾位就停，不需要 FNC1。
blocks.en: Fixed length (such as (01) = 14 digits, (17) = 6 digits): the scanner knows how many digits to read and stops, so FNC1 is not needed.

blocks.zh: 可變長度（如 (10) 批號最多20位，(21) 序號最多20位）：掃描器不知道何時停，必須在欄位末尾加 FNC1（除非是整個條碼的最後一個欄位）。
blocks.en: Variable length (such as (10) lot number, up to 20 characters, and (21) serial number, up to 20 characters): the scanner cannot tell where the field ends, so an FNC1 must be added at the end of the field (unless it is the last field in the whole barcode).

blocks.zh: FNC1 傳輸給電腦時變成 ASCII GS 字元（十進位 29）。
blocks.en: When transmitted to the computer, FNC1 becomes the ASCII GS character (decimal 29).

blocks.zh: DSCSA / EU FMD 與 AI 碼對應關係
blocks.en: Mapping DSCSA / EU FMD to AI codes

blocks.zh: 注意：DSCSA（美國）和 EU FMD（歐盟）對序列化的要求都是基於 GS1 AI 系統，但 EU FMD 要求 DataMatrix（2D），DSCSA 則允許 DataMatrix 或 GS1-128。
blocks.en: Note: The serialization requirements of both the DSCSA (US) and the EU FMD (EU) are based on the GS1 AI system, but the EU FMD requires DataMatrix (2D), whereas the DSCSA allows either DataMatrix or GS1-128.

blocks.zh: Practice Questions 練習題
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: Q1 — Scope Boundary 範圍邊界
blocks.en: Q1 — Scope Boundary

blocks.zh: 您的 CDMO 將一批凍乾粉針棧板出貨至歐洲經銷商，外箱條碼直接印在瓦楞紙牛皮紙面上。ISO 15394 適用嗎？
blocks.en: Your CDMO ships a pallet of lyophilized powder for injection to a European distributor, and the shipping carton barcode is printed directly on the kraft-coloured corrugated surface. Does ISO 15394 apply?

blocks.zh: Show Answer 顯示答案
blocks.en: Show Answer

blocks.zh:
No. Clause 1 explicitly states this document is not applicable to direct printing on kraft coloured corrugated surfaces. Guidance for that scenario is in references such as The Fibre Box Handbook. For a compliant solution, apply a separate printed label affixed to the corrugated case.

不適用。第1條明確排除直接印在瓦楞紙牛皮紙面上的條碼。合規解決方案是在外箱上貼附獨立印刷的標籤。
blocks.en:
No. Clause 1 explicitly states this document is not applicable to direct printing on kraft coloured corrugated surfaces. Guidance for that scenario is in references such as The Fibre Box Handbook.

Compliant solution: apply a separate printed label affixed to the corrugated case.

blocks.zh: Q2 — AI Code Identification AI 碼識別
blocks.en: Q2 — AI Code Identification

blocks.zh: 辨識每個 AI 的含義，並指出哪些是可變長度欄位（需要 FNC1）？
blocks.en: Identify the meaning of each AI, and indicate which are variable-length fields (requiring FNC1).

blocks.zh: (10) 批號在 (17) 之前，為可變長度，故需要 FNC1 分隔。(21) 如果是最後一個欄位則可省略 FNC1。
blocks.en: (10) lot number comes before (17) and is variable length, so an FNC1 separator is required. (21) may omit the FNC1 if it is the last field.

blocks.zh: Q3 — SSCC Structure SSCC 結構
blocks.en: Q3 — SSCC Structure

blocks.zh: QA 詢問：SSCC 最多幾位，使用哪個 AI？SSCC 可以含小寫字母嗎？
blocks.en: QA asks: how many digits can an SSCC have, and which AI does it use? Can an SSCC contain lowercase letters?

blocks.zh:
SSCC uses AI (00) and is always exactly 18 digits (numeric only). The full encoded string including AI is 20 characters: "(00)" + 18 digits. Per Clause 5.2.1, the unique transport unit identifier shall contain only numeric and upper-case alphabetic characters — no lowercase letters are permitted.

SSCC 使用 AI (00)，固定 18 位純數字。含 AI 的完整字串為 20 個字元。依據 5.2.1 條，唯一運輸單元識別碼只能含數字和大寫英文字母，不允許小寫字母。
blocks.en:
SSCC uses AI (00) and is always exactly 18 digits (numeric only). The full encoded string including AI is 20 characters: "(00)" + 18 digits.

Per Clause 5.2.1, the unique transport unit identifier shall contain only numeric and upper-case alphabetic characters; no lowercase letters are permitted.

blocks.zh: Q4 — Base vs Extended Label 基本標籤 vs 擴展標籤
blocks.en: Q4 — Base vs Extended Label

blocks.zh: 物流夥伴說棧板標籤只需 SSCC + 收件地址；法規團隊說批號和有效期也必須顯示。依 ISO 15394，誰對？用哪種標籤格式解決？
blocks.en: The logistics partner says the pallet label needs only the SSCC + the consignee address; the regulatory team says the lot number and expiry date must also be shown. Under ISO 15394, who is right, and which label format resolves it?

blocks.zh:
Both are correct in their context. ISO 15394 Clause 4.4.1 states the base label requires only SSCC + Ship To — adequate when full EDI data exchange is established. However, Clause 4.4.2 specifies the extended label for when EDI is insufficient or trading partners require additional visible data. Pharmaceutical regulations (DSCSA, EU FMD) mandate lot/expiry visibility on the physical label, requiring the extended label format with AI(10) and AI(17) in the supplier segment.

兩者在各自情境下都正確。基本標籤（4.4.1）只要求 SSCC + Ship To；擴展標籤（4.4.2）用於 EDI 不完備或需要在實體標籤上顯示額外資料的情況。製藥法規（DSCSA、EU FMD）要求批號和有效期必須在實物上可見，故須使用擴展標籤格式，在供應商區段加入 AI(10) 和 AI(17)。
blocks.en:
Both are correct in their context. ISO 15394 Clause 4.4.1 states the base label requires only SSCC + Ship To, which is adequate when full EDI data exchange is established. However, Clause 4.4.2 specifies the extended label for when EDI is insufficient or trading partners require additional visible data.

Pharmaceutical regulations (DSCSA, EU FMD) mandate lot/expiry visibility on the physical label, requiring the extended label format with AI(10) and AI(17) in the supplier segment.

blocks.zh: Q5 — Normative References 規範性引用
blocks.en: Q5 — Normative References

blocks.zh: 討論用 PDF417 還是 DataMatrix 在出貨標籤上編碼完整品質檢驗報告（CoA）。哪個 ISO 標準規定 2D 符號的資料語法？哪個規定 PDF417 符號本身？
blocks.en: You are discussing whether to use PDF417 or DataMatrix to encode the full certificate of analysis (CoA) on a shipping label. Which ISO standard specifies the data syntax for 2D symbols, and which specifies the PDF417 symbol itself?

blocks.zh:
Data syntax inside 2D symbols is governed by ISO/IEC 15434 (Syntax for high-capacity ADC media) — this applies to both PDF417 and DataMatrix. The PDF417 symbology specification is ISO/IEC 15438:2015. The DataMatrix symbology specification is ISO/IEC 16022. Per Clause 5.4.3, supporting documentation encoded in 2D symbols on transport labels shall conform to ISO/IEC 15434.

2D 符號內的資料語法由 ISO/IEC 15434（高容量 ADC 媒體語法）規定，適用於 PDF417 和 DataMatrix。PDF417 符號規格本身由 ISO/IEC 15438:2015 規定；DataMatrix 由 ISO/IEC 16022 規定。依據 5.4.3 條，運輸標籤上 2D 符號中的支援文件須符合 ISO/IEC 15434。
blocks.en:
Data syntax inside 2D symbols is governed by ISO/IEC 15434 (Syntax for high-capacity ADC media); this applies to both PDF417 and DataMatrix.

The PDF417 symbology specification is ISO/IEC 15438:2015; the DataMatrix symbology specification is ISO/IEC 16022. Per Clause 5.4.3, supporting documentation encoded in 2D symbols on transport labels shall conform to ISO/IEC 15434.
